claims.metric: contribution of structural proximity prediction to downstream classification
claims.quote: Our empirical examination also shows that the explicit prediction of structural proximity has no contributions to the downstream classification tasks in GraphMAE (see Figure 1b).

claims.metric: recommended mask ratio
claims.quote: Additionally, similar to MAE [12], a relatively large mask ratio (e.g., 50%) is necessary to reduce redundancy in the attributed graphs in most cases and thus form a challenging self-supervision to learn meaningful node representations.

claims.metric: effect of leave-unchanged strategy
claims.quote: Our experiments find that the "leave-unchanged" strategy actually harms GraphMAE's learning, while the "random-substitution" method could help form more high-quality representations.
